question: Does preservation of original source markings select the gauge charge whose unit-flux index is n and whose full integral neutral quotient is E8?
summary_de: Im festgelegten I(9,1)-Randwoerterbuch selektiert volle F(E8)-Neutralitaet mit Erhaltung der urspruenglichen globalen q- oder Y-Markierung die primitive Ladung g=+/-K n. n-Neutralitaet ist jetzt Folge statt Auswahlvoraussetzung; F bleibt vorausgesetzt. Der bedingte signierte Index eines kompakten U(1)-Einheitsflusses ist +/-n und reproduziert12Fermionfaktoren,3Ableitungen sowie freie Gewichte(9/2,9/2). Das gesamte neutrale Integralquotientengitter ist E8, mit expliziter A8-Index3-Darstellung und72+84+84Wurzeln. Die9+1-Ladungsstruktur ist bekannte E8-Parton/Cluston-Prior-Art(Wang2015), keine neue Ursprungsphysik. Native Eichquelle, Flussamplitude, Phase, Zustands-/Zeitabbildung und volleIR-Stromalgebra bleiben offen. Die bestehende zentrale Feldobstruktion wird nicht durch Gauging-Notation aufgehoben.
assumptions: Fixed integral I_(9,1) boundary dictionary and its existing F(E8), q and Y embeddings
Primitive nonzero integral U(1) candidate and preservation of q or Y under flux
For physical index interpretation only: compact U(1) connection coupled through g on a fixed oriented spin two-manifold
The old native rotor has not been identified with these ten chiral channels
The local coincident vertex uses ordinary chiral free-field point splitting; its amplitude and physical time are not selected
kills: Treat agreement of P1 unit winding and unit U(1) flux as an already constructed source operator map.
Infer a nonzero cosine Hamiltonian, its coefficient, phase or vacuum merely from zero-mode saturation or the flux index.
Treat the algebraic quotient identification x~x+n as an already derived dynamical equality of all correlators.
Promote norm-two quotient representatives with UV weights(3/2,1/2) to dimension-one currents over the unchanged free vacuum.
Claim novelty for the known nine charge-one plus one opposite charge-three E8 gauging mechanism.
Transfer a chosen2+1D gapped parton bulk or its confinement dynamics to TFPT without the missing source, state and time maps.
leaves_open: Source-derived charged or twisted field sectors and a faithful operator/charge/parity/state/time map
Actual compact gauge field, gauge measure, flux amplitudes and their phase dependence
Physical realization of the integral quotient, gauge/glue sectors and infrared correlation algebra
Gravitational completion of the signature8 boundary
Source-selected dynamics, vacuum, chiral matter and common3+1D continuum
All T1-T8 physical closures and a complete TOE
not_claimed: No new gauge Hamiltonian or native flux sector has been implemented
No independent origin of E8 from P1/P2: the F(E8) embedding is retained as input
No generic confinement theorem, no IR or cosine exponentiation theorem
No erasure of original physical fermions; the neutral bosonic quotient is not a full matter reconstruction
Finite controls and an internal review are not external peer review or a proof-assistant formalization
